content.text:
h01.

**Component** — the S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`), defined in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`. Its `CheckAndPresign` method walks all S3-backed attachments and re-signs any whose presigned URL is within 4 days of its 5-day expiry, updating the stored `Reference` URL so the externally-stored (S3) attachment links never go stale (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:47-132`).

**Schedule** — every 12 hours, via a `time.Ticker` (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, ticker loop at `:29-41`). It also runs once immediately at startup.

**Wiring site** — `server/server.go:162-171`: the runner is constructed, `RunOnce(ctx)` is called immediately, then `Run(s3Context)` is launched in a background goroutine (registered under `s.backgroundRunnerWG`). Import at `server/server.go:25`.

So: `s3presign.Runner.Run` (re-presigns near-expiry S3 attachment URLs) — every 12h (plus one run at boot) — `server/server.go:162` (goroutine launch at `server/server.go:169`).
